summary: Define various categories (heads) under which amounts can be collected from students during the admission process, such as registration fees or prospectus fees.
steps: Navigate to the Admission Heads section.
Click 'Add New' or similar to create a new admission head.
Enter a descriptive name for the head (e.g., 'Registration Fees', 'Prospectus Fees', 'Visit Fee').
business_rules: All collections from students during the admission process must be associated with a defined admission head.
Token Money is a predefined special head with unique adjustment rules.
important_notes: Carefully name admission heads to reflect their purpose.
Token Money cannot be created manually and has specific behavior regarding fee adjustment.
questions: How do I create new admission heads for different types of fees?
What are admission heads used for in the ERP system?
Can I define custom fee types for admission collections?
related_topics: Token Money vs. Other Admission Heads (Fee Adjustment)
